entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: Pyromancer and mage-pirate who built Spitfire Bastion and later oversaw Sunray Bay.

entities.name: Spitfire Bastion
entities.description: Fortress Vance blasted from a coastal cliff.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirate group that uses Spitfire Bastion.

entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: Representative of Downtown dispatched to investigate.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Vance was appointed.

events.summary: Vance blasted a coastal cliff with her artillery to create Spitfire Bastion.
events.quote: she blasted the cliffside to create a fortress she named Spitfire Bastion

events.summary: After the invasion Vance was appointed to oversee Sunray Bay.
events.quote: Ripley Vance was appointed to oversee Sunray Bay

events.summary: Vance sent Malcolm Lee to investigate Downtown's disappearance.
events.quote: Vance dispatched the town’s official representative, Malcolm Lee , to investigate

events.summary: Sunray Bay fell under the control of the Mycotyrant and Vance's fate became unknown.
events.quote: Sunray Bay fell under the control of the Mycotyrant

relations.note: Hosts its members at her bastion
relations.quote: Spitfire Bastion has become a favored stop for members of the Brazen Coalition
